about.text:
Drawn from the real screens' code, with National Extension College's real websites and rivals from your local data (19 Oct 2026).

The wording Auto Setup writes on boards 3 to 6 and 8 (names, profile, searches, questions, costs) is my example of what it would write, not its output; so are the costs on board 8. Board 10's company description and About are examples too.

New on these boards: Auto Setup's line and button above the websites (1 to 3); the 'Hakken wrote this from…' line under each box it filled, in the words Auto Classify already uses (4, 10); the 'Written by Hakken · from…' line under each search and question (5, 6); 'by Auto Setup' under a question's date (6); and the Auto Setup agent itself (7 to 9).

Not drawn: a spend cap per day. Today only the DataForSEO Collector has one; board 9 shows the cap per run.
